Reclaim **0.1.1-1572**

0.1.1-1572
- System partition cleanup offers Standard and Deep modes; Deep previews each item's effect and asks for an extra confirmation.
- The system partition warning starts at 900 MB free, and Settings can turn it off; cleanup stays on the Overview card.
- Pages, dialogs and buttons follow the DSM look of UI 0.10.
- Built on SDK 0.12.1: an administrator approves Syno Reclaim again after the upgrade.

Package: `synopackageland/SynoReclaim`
